VizagTransit — Live Vizag Bus Tracking & APSRTC Visakhapatnam Bus Tracker

VizagTransit (also searched as Vizag Transit) is a free, real-time public transport tracker for Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. Monitor live APSRTC city and regional buses on an interactive street and satellite map, view live GPS vehicle positions, check stop-by-stop progress timelines, and plan bus journeys across 276 routes and 521 bus stops.

Key Features for Visakhapatnam Commuters

  • Real-Time GPS Bus Tracking: Watch hundreds of live APSRTC buses move across Vizag with vehicle registration numbers, speed, and live freshness status.
  • Live Stop Progress & ETAs: Tap any bus to inspect completed stops, your bus's exact position between stops, next stop arrival estimates, and upcoming stops.
  • Point-to-Point Journey Planner: Find direct and scheduled buses between any two stops in Visakhapatnam, including outbound and return directions.
  • Satellite & Dark Map Modes: Switch seamlessly between clean vector street maps, light/dark themes, and satellite imagery.

Frequently Asked Questions

How can I track Vizag APSRTC city buses live?

Visit VizagTransit at https://vizagtransit.duckdns.org/ to see live APSRTC buses on the map, search by bus number (such as 55, 500Y, 400, 38, or 6A), or search between two bus stops.

Is VizagTransit free to use?

Yes. VizagTransit is completely free for all Visakhapatnam commuters with zero login requirements and 24/7 live updates.
